{{Top}}
[[File:Victory_II-class_Star_Destroyer_SWArmada.png|thumb|350px|[[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyers]] bombard a planet]]
{{Quote|Wipe this pathetic planet from the face of the galaxy!|[[Darth Malak]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Orbital bombardment''' was a strategy used many times throughout the [[Timeline of galactic history/Legends|history]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], in which a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] or [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-based machine bombarded a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] heavily. Unlike a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]], which completely devastated a planet, orbital bombardment could be made more precise or specific.

==Usage==
The most effective means of doing this was using several capital ships to target a specific area on a planet. Although such an action was expected to cause collateral damage, some gunnery crews were reputed to be skilled to the degree of pin-point accuracy. Regardless, there were many factions which used orbital bombardment. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were very adept at using this in the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The planet [[Telos IV]] was also [[Bombing of Telos IV|attacked]] by orbital bombardment. [[Darth Malak]] used this to [[Destruction of Taris|attack]] the planet of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], while looking for [[Bastila Shan]] and also [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|bombarded]] the [[Jedi Enclave|Enclave]] on [[Attack on Dantooine (Jedi Civil War)|Dantooine]], although most of the Jedi survived.

[[File:Orbital_bombardment.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] bombarding the planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]].]]

The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Bombardment of Humbarine/Legends|bombarded]] the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] of [[Humbarine/Legends|Humbarine]] in a [[Base Delta Zero/Legends|Base Delta Zero]] operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], melting the crust of the planet. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] also engaged in orbital bombardments and made use of the tactic to destroy deeply entrenched Separatist armies.<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], Emperor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] [[Caamas Firestorm|commenced]] a Base Delta Zero on the planet [[Caamas/Legends|Caamas]] with the help of a group of [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] infiltrators. The bombardment would result in complete, total destruction of the planet, and with only a few remaining [[Caamasi/Legends|Caamasi]] species. Years later, it would led to a [[Caamas Document Crisis|political crisis]]. Captain [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] also initiated a bombardment on the planet [[Oben]] which would mark the end of the [[Kaleesh–Imperial conflict|conflict]] between the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] and Empire.

Orbital bombardment was frequently used in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and was a factor during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|Battle of Kashyyyk]]. The planet of [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] was [[Defense of Ralltiir|subjected]] to orbital bombardment for harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] scientists. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] planned to use this strategy against [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. However, the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]] and [[planetary ion cannon]] of Echo Base enabled the Rebels to hold off the bombardment and evacuate much of their equipment and personnel. Often, strike teams and special forces would be dispatched to the planet in order to sabotage such defenses prior to the initiation of the bombardment.

During [[Operation Shadow Hand]], [[Superior General]] [[Sander Delvardus]], [[Battle of Metellos (Galactic Civil War)|attacked]] the planet [[Metellos]] and bombarded it from above, killing 5 billion.

[[File:Orbital-bombardment-art.png|thumb|230px|Orbital bombardment]]

While a common tactic for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]&mdash;in fact, some sources imply that Star Destroyers were optimized for such attacks&mdash;the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic Defense Force]] was reluctant to engage in orbital bombardment, for fear of civilian casualties. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], however, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] ordered the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' to bombard [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] in an attempt to save the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] ground base during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battles of Borleias]], and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] also made orbital bombardment one of his standing orders in the prelude to the [[Battle of Ebaq]] 9.

Orbital bombardment was also employed during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]; [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk (Second Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Kashyyyk]] opened fire on the planet with the [[long-range turbolaser]]s of the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']]. His attack succeeded in its objective of initiating massive, self-sustaining forest fires; Solo intended the devastation to serve as a warning for those who might betray the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].

==Behind the scenes==
Orbital bombardment appears in [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] as a strategic combat action allowing the player to use a fleet unit in orbit around a planet to eliminate the opponents' ground units located on that planet. This option is called ''planetary bombardment'' in the game. In ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]'', orbital bombardments are available to both the Rebellion (ion bombardment) and the Empire (turbolaser) as well as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] (ion then plasma bombardment).

Orbital bombardment appeared in all of the [[Battlefront]] series. In the [[Star Wars: Battlefront|first game]], [[Probe droid/Legends|recon droids]] could signal for them, in the [[Star Wars: Battlefront II|second]], a frigate on Hoth during the final campaign mission was bombarded, and in [[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron|Renegade Squadron]] and [[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron|Elite Squadron]], a special gun would tag a location for bombardment.
